name: nexuscare
description: Nexus Care — AI-assisted telemedicine and healthcare management platform (prototype).

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @nexuscare/api && npm run build -w @nexuscare/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
